decisions.reason: The formwork profile line sits in the core offer and had its own page, and with no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations there is no trigger for problemistic search, even though 2020–2021 visibility is unobserved.
Automated flow control supports the firm's stated automation strategy, and the slack of an expanding firm lets it keep carrying a product whose results are still uncertain.

Shuttering magnet blocks are a low-cost core formwork line, so little would be gained by dropping them, though the earlier withdrawal of the related strips shows the magnetic range does get consolidated.
This magnetic component had dedicated web presence and complements the core range cheaply, so it likely meets aspirations despite the consolidation seen with Product D.
Its weak presence and overlap with Product E make it the most likely candidate for consolidation, but without a clear performance shortfall the growing firm keeps it for now.
